content.short: PowerDEX offers advanced crypto options trading with 100,000+ contracts across 80 altcoins, BTC, and ETH.
content.description: PowerDEX pioneers the first decentralized platform for trading altcoin options, addressing the lack of advanced derivatives in DeFi. While most users remain limited to basic spot or perpetual trading and lack tools to hedge risk or express directional views with precision, PowerDEX enables traders to buy and sell calls and puts on a broad range of altcoins with flexible expiration dates, directly from their wallets and without custodial intermediaries. By removing custodians, it gives traders full control of funds while supporting hedging strategies and nuanced market views through customizable expiration options.
